description: Two lines of maths, repeated millions of times, drawn as silk. The four knobs are the four letters in the formula.

controls.action: The four knobs are a, b, c and d in the formula. Turn one and the whole figure bends; let go and it sharpens as the points gather.
Turn the figure in space. Let go while moving and it keeps spinning.
Music: the App plays one of its own pieces and the figure moves with it. Hold again for the next piece, then the audio input, then off.
Any knob: switch it between fine steps (0.01) and coarse steps (0.10).
Open Menu for Guide, audio, Reload or Exit.
Next preset. The letters glide there, so you see the figure change.
Sound on or off: hear the formula.
Next motion: spin, drift (the letters sway slowly), both, or none.
Next formula, at its first preset.
Next thing to follow: Strange Loop, Sacred Orbit, the audio input, or nothing.
Show or hide the formula, the letters and the number of points.
Set it spinning. Drag to stop.

sections.title: The picture
sections.text: Each formula takes a point and gives the next one. The App follows many points at once and counts where they land: the more often a place is hit, the brighter it is. Every figure has depth: for a two-line formula it is where each point was one step before. While anything moves the figure is a little grainy; at rest the points gather to several million and the picture becomes smooth, then stops. Some settings collapse to a few points, which the device screen says; K2 always leads back to a preset. A large output shows the figure only, with no text.

sections.title: Sound
sections.text: Everything is silent until you hold a key. K4 chooses what the figure follows: one of the App's own two pieces of music, which it plays round and round, or the audio input, which opens only while it is chosen and is never played back or kept. The low, middle and high parts of the sound sway a, b and c, and sudden swells nudge d; the letters return when it stops. Sound (K2) plays one point moving through the formula, x on the left and y on the right. Choose inputs and outputs and set levels in Menu.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: The formula, a, b, c and d, the colours, the view, spin, drift and whether the text shows save automatically. Sound, music and the audio input start off each time. A shared link opens the same figure from the same side.
